title: Register GA4 custom dimensions for lead and CTA parameters
description:
As Ryan, I want lead_source, solution, cta_location and cta_text registered as event-scoped custom dimensions so that I can break leads and CTA clicks down by source, solution and placement.

Steps (Ryan): GA4 Admin > Data display > Custom definitions > Create custom dimension, scope Event, one per parameter name (lead_source, solution, cta_location, cta_text), using the exact parameter names.

Acceptance criteria:
Scenario: Dimensions registered
  Given the four custom dimensions are created with event scope
  When Ryan opens Admin > Custom definitions
  Then lead_source, solution, cta_location and cta_text are listed
Scenario: Usable in analysis
  Given events with those parameters have arrived after registration
  When Ryan builds a report or Exploration
  Then each dimension is available and shows values

Note: dimensions only populate for events received after registration. Dependencies: none to start; best done before the live verification so test events populate them.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Update 2026-11-12: with web3f4 and Machines-on-Machines PR 230, also register event-scoped dimensions form_id, error_kind, promotion_id, promotion_name, creative_name and location_id (the promotion ones may already exist as built-in ecommerce dimensions: check first). Campaign source is a built-in dimension.
